summary: Iteration 12 retested the 8 follow-up items from iteration 11 on PREVIEW (API, UI and offline scorer). VERIFIED (6 of 8): (1) The big score shows one decimal: 97.7, 23.4 and 59.9 display as-is, and integers show without decimals (96 / 100, 100 / 100). (2) The heading reads 'Your three measures' and 'five stats' no longer appears. (3) /how-to-play step 2 subtitle reads 'Every translation is evaluated on three measures: quality, glossary, and timeliness & completion.' (4) Profile history medals are data-state=locked for 22.7, 23.4 and 0, and won for 96, 100, 59.9 and 97.7. (5) The report card kicker is right in every case. qa.cr6 primary ch2 (23.4 < 96), qa.cr7 primary ch2 (23.4 < 97.7) and qa.cr6 trial ch3 (59.9 < 100) show 'TITLE HELD · BEST STANDS', +0.0 and no badge-sweep-once. First wins (qa.cr7 97.7, qa.cr6 96, trial 100) show 'TITLE UNLOCKED', the sweep, and +4.9 / +4.8 / +3.0. (6) The Sahayika panel lists the opening line, then the level line, then high_score or not_new_best, so no announce lines are dropped. (8) scripts/emergent/test-otp.sh works with DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET unset: the planted code verifies with 200 and a wrong code is rejected. PARTIAL (7) Fluency: the offline scorer gives pure CAG reference text TQ 55/55, fluency 1.0 and score 100, so the refKeys filter works. A real submission is different. qa.cr7 Primary with the reference in every field and all parts done scored 97.7 with TQ 52.7/55 and fluency 0.902. Cause: the server re-adds locked chips like '83 per cent', and grammarIssues then flags 'per' and 'cent' as latin_word (34 own issues). That ~2.5 TQ penalty is one no player can avoid. Also, a stale FAQ answer and a contradictory Sahayika line on held re-attempts.

minor.issue: latin_word check uses `!f.locked.includes(w)`. f.locked holds whole phrases ('83 per cent'), so the single words 'per'/'cent' inside locked chips are always flagged. Players can't remove locked chips (game.ts:179 re-adds them), so every page with Latin text in locked chips loses fluency. Offline on r38-primary-bundle: pure reference gives TQ 55 and fluency 1.0. Reference with the locked chips inline gives TQ 52.5, fluency 0.897 and 44 latin issues. Real submission: TQ 52.7. Fix: build a Set of words from the locked phrases (f.locked.flatMap(words)) and test w against it.

On a lower re-attempt after the title was already won, announce still includes '<round>.report_card.title_earned_first_chance' ('Brilliant, QA! Welcome, Anuvad Nipun. 4.8 more credits are yours.'). This contradicts the +0.0 chip and the 'Title held · best stands' kicker shown just below it, and it appears on every later attempt. Fix: push it only when this attempt first crosses the mark (score >= passMark && (priorBest ?? -1) < passMark).

Typed question 'How am I scored?' outside a round matches the FAQ and returns stale 'Five measures: translation quality, time, completion, glossary terms and sentence construction...' (Hindi 'पाँच मानक'). Knowledge facts are updated, but this FAQ entry is not.
The tip uses unfiltered grammar[0], so a reference-perfect attempt still gets 'end every sentence with a full stop (।)' for issues CAG's own Hindi also has. Use own(grammar).

ui_bugs.issue: heldOnly = titleEarned && score < best. A higher re-attempt after the title was already won (new best, e.g. 40 -> 60) still shows 'Title unlocked', the sweep and +roundCredits (the full round total, not the delta gained). An attempt equal to the best on a later chance behaves the same way. Not reproduced live: no such player exists, and it would spend chances.

integration_issues.issue: The Sahayika panel's second line claims new credits and welcomes the title again, while the chip shows +0.0 (backend announce issue above)

action_items: scoring.ts:186: exempt the words inside locked phrases from latin_word (split f.locked into words). Without this, a near-reference draft-round answer can't reach 55 TQ on pages with 'per cent' chips.
rules.ts:156-157: add title_earned_first_chance to announce only when this attempt first wins the title; for a held title, rely on not_new_best.
content/sahayika.script.json faq.before_game 'How am I scored?': update the en and hi answers to three measures (55/25/20).

Optional: scoring.ts:288 tip from the filtered (own) grammar; Report.tsx heldOnly could compare against priorBest/pass mark so a higher re-attempt after a win shows the credit delta; stale comment Report.tsx:57 'five stats'.
critical_code_review_comments: rules.ts reportCardLines: titleEarned = best >= passMark is used both for 'has title' and 'won now'. Separate the two (wonNow vs held).
Report.tsx credits chip shows r.roundCredits (the cumulative round credits) as '+X'. It is only right on a first win.

game.ts:179 re-adds missing locked tokens at the END of the field text, so an answer that translated '83 per cent' as '83 प्रतिशत' gets a stray chip tail, which adds a missing_danda and lowers chrF. Consider whether CAG's reference ('प्रतिशत') conflicts with locking 'per cent' at all.

rca of the issue: Fluency cap: grammarIssues line 186 compares each word to f.locked (an array of multi-word phrases), so words inside locked chips are never exempt. The refKeys filter doesn't remove them because the reference has 'प्रतिशत', not 'per cent'.
